user.title: Login Analyser
user.description: Records every failed login / unauthorised request to Home Assistant, works out where it came from and what it was trying, and can block attackers.

data.whitelist_successful_logins: Never ban IPs that logged in successfully

data_description.ban_enabled: Ban IPs that fail too often or send exploit probes.
data_description.max_attempts: Ban an IP after this many failures within the time window.
data_description.find_time_minutes: Failures are counted within this many minutes.
data_description.ban_time_minutes: How long the first ban lasts. 0 = permanent.
data_description.escalate_repeat_offenders: Each further ban doubles the duration.
data_description.instant_ban_probes: Immediately ban requests that are never legitimate for HA (WordPress, Joomla, .env, router exploits, path traversal...).
data_description.whitelist: IPs or CIDR ranges that are never banned, comma or newline separated (e.g. your work IP, 100.64.0.0/10 for Tailscale).
data_description.whitelist_private: Protects devices on your home network.
data_description.whitelist_successful_logins: IPs with a successful login in the last 30 days are trusted.
data_description.capture_passwords: Only recorded when the username does NOT exist in Home Assistant, so your own typos are never stored.
data_description.geoip_lookup: Country, city, ISP, ASN, hosting/proxy detection. Free, no key.
data_description.shodan_internetdb: Open ports, known CVEs and tags such as 'compromised' or 'scanner'. Free, no key.
data_description.abuseipdb_api_key: Free key from abuseipdb.com gives an abuse confidence score and report count.
data_description.notify_service: e.g. notify.mobile_app_your_phone. Max one message per IP per hour (bans always notify).
data_description.replace_builtin_notification: Swap the generic notification for a detailed one.

unban_ip.description: Remove a ban (also removes it from ip_bans.yaml).

lookup_ip.name: Look up IP
lookup_ip.description: Run GeoIP / rDNS / Shodan / AbuseIPDB lookups for an IP and return the result.
